SM58 sheet: 'Three-pin professional audio connector (male XLR type)'. M-Track Solo page: 'Mic Input (balanced XLR)'.
Hosa sheet: 'Pro Mic Cable, XLR3F to XLR3M'. AT2035 sheet: 'Output Connector Integral 3-pin XLRM-type'.

Yeti Orb sheet: 'Connector: USB-C to USB-A'. M-Track Solo page: mic input is 'balanced XLR' combo; a USB mic cannot plug into it.
SC18 page: 'USB-A to USB-C Cable (1.5m)'. SM58 sheet: 'Three-pin professional audio connector (male XLR type)'.

UCA202 sheet: 'Line in connectors RCA, unbalanced', no mic input. SM58 sheet: 'Three-pin professional audio connector (male XLR type)'.
Adapter case. PSA1 page: 'Thread Size 3/8', box contains '1 x PSA1' only. SM58 sheet: 'standard 5/8 in.-27 thread'. Needs a 3/8 to 5/8 adapter that is not in the bundle.
Adapter case. Compass page: '5/8-inch threading, adapter for 3/8-inch threading'. Yeti Orb sheet: 'any 1/4-20 threaded mount'. Needs a 1/4 adapter that is not in the bundle.
Under-powered case: works but quiet. HD 600 page: 'Impedance 300 ohm'. M-Track Solo page: headphone 'Power 60 mW/Ch, 32 Ω'; a 32 ohm-rated output will drive 300 ohm headphones quietly.
Under-powered case: works but quiet. DT 770 sheet: '250 ohm version'. UCA202 sheet: phones out '2 x 3.7 mW @ 100 ohm'; that low power drives 250 ohm headphones quietly.
